title_en: GTA 6 Preload Times and Install Size Confirmed, Rockstar Announces Physical Cover Art Poster and Map of Leonida
summary_en: Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload times as well as the install size of the game.
body_en:
Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload times as well as the install size of the game.
Digital preloading on PS5 kicks off at midnight local time in your respective timezone on Tuesday, November 10, Rockstar said . On Xbox Series X and S it’s slightly different — preloading begins on Tuesday, November 10 at 12am GMT (UK time). That's 4pm PT and 7pm ET on Novemember 9. Code-in-box versions for both consoles “should” be available from retailers beginning November 12, Rockstar added.
GTA 6 itself launches globally on November 19, using the local midnight release timing strategy across PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
As for the install size, Rockstar confirmed that the preload file weighs in at up to 212 GB, “depending on your device.” “So make sure you've got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible,” Rockstar said.
Elsewhere, Rockstar said that on November 19, the day GTA 6 comes out, it will add an official printable GTA 6 cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site. A double-sided physical version of this poster will also be made available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store — for $0.99 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store.
